greeting: The stars whisper your name! They speak of... possibilities!
Soluna greets you! Reader of skies! Seer of fates!
Welcome to the Observatory! Where the heavens reveal their secrets!
Day and night, I watch! Sun AND moon! Both have stories!
Your aura... interesting! Clouded, but with bright spots!
Seeking guidance? The celestial bodies provide! For a small donation!
Come! Look through my telescope! See your destiny written in stars!
dialog.fortune_telling: The constellations shift! Your path is... flexible! Many branches! Some lead to glory! Others to... snacks! Both good!
dialog.astrology_lecture: The Sun represents vitality! The Moon represents mystery! Together they dance! Like cosmic partners! Beautiful!
dialog.horoscope_offer: Today's horoscope? Let me consult the charts! ...Mercury is doing something! Important!
haggle: Knowledge of the cosmos? Priceless! But I'll take fifty gold!
For you? A cosmic discount! Forty gold!
The stars suggest generosity! Thirty gold!
Fine! Twenty gold! But I'm losing cosmic money here!
purchase_success: The stars align! For you! Specifically!
Your fortune is... interesting! Mostly good!
The universe has spoken! Through me! As proxy!
purchase_fail: No gold, no guidance! The stars charge consultation fees!
Even the cosmos has bills to pay!
Come back when the stars align with your wallet!
rumor: The Remnant Vault blocks all astrological readings! A void in the cosmic tapestry!
I predicted the aeronaut's success! Also their bankruptcy! Both came true! Eventually!
The twins and I share visions! But they see halves! I see wholes!
A new star appeared last week! But only I can see it! Suspicious!
The trenchcoat person's fate is... unreadable! Blank! Like a void!
dialog.quest_hook: A fallen star! In the Frost peaks! I need its essence for my readings! Bring me Stardust Crystal and I'll reveal your TRUE destiny!
dialog.quest_active: The Stardust Crystal calls to you! From the frozen peaks! Can you hear it?
dialog.quest_complete: THE ESSENCE! So pure! So cosmic! Your destiny is... prosperity! And friendship! And this reward!
dialog.quest_reward: Celestial Lens - See hidden auras and cosmic alignments!
farewell: May the stars guide your path! But not literally! That would hurt!
The cosmos watches! Always! Creepy but comforting!
Return when the heavens call! Or when bored!
dialog.time_noon: The sun reigns! But the moon still watches! Patient!
dialog.time_dusk: Twilight! Both celestial bodies visible! My favorite time!
dialog.time_night: The moon commands the sky! Secrets revealed in silver light!

party_reactions.kade: The stars tell you... what, exactly?
party_reactions.nix7: Astronomical data outdated by 300 years. Shall I correct you?
party_reactions.twist: You can tell the FUTURE?! Tell me mine!
party_reactions.korr: There is wisdom in watching the skies. The spirits speak there too.
party_reactions.renna: Astrology is not astronomy. But the telescope is impressive.
party_reactions.suresh: The celestial dance reflects our own. We are all stardust.
party_reactions.sova: Can you predict arrow trajectories? No? Useless.
party_reactions.grit: I prefer my stars in navigation charts. Less mystical nonsense.
party_reactions.ashka: The sun is basically fire, right? Tell me about fire stars!
party_reactions.senna: What's my horoscope? 'Don't get caught?' Good advice.
party_reactions.callum: So beautiful! The stars, I mean! And your headdress!
party_reactions.petra: Rocks falling from space. Dangerous. Interesting, but dangerous.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Your palm... interesting lines! Many adventures ahead!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning seeker! The stars noted your absence!
relationship_dialog.friend: My cosmic companion! I read the skies for you specially!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Destiny-bound friend! We are linked by celestial thread!

mini_quest.title: Stardust Seeker
mini_quest.description: Find a Stardust Crystal from Frost peaks for Soluna's readings

stages.hook: A fallen star! In Frost! Its essence would POWER my scrying!
stages.active: The frozen peaks! Look for blue-white crystal! It hums!
stages.complete: PERFECT! The cosmic vibrations! Here! A lens to see hidden truths!
